why.title: The DualGrid difference
why.subtitle: We're not a large agency. We're a small team that treats every project as if it were our own.

items.title: 100% custom design
items.desc: No templates. Every site is unique and designed from scratch for your brand.

items.title: Full service
items.desc: You just approve. We handle everything: design, code, domain and hosting.

items.title: Direct communication
items.desc: Clear, barrier-free communication. WhatsApp support throughout the project.

items.title: We build what you need
items.desc: No feature limits. If you need it, we build it.

items.title: Perfect on all devices
items.desc: Responsive design from the first sketch. Works on mobile, tablet and desktop.

items.title: Clean and secure code
items.desc: We follow security and performance best practices on every project.

process.title: Clear process, predictable results
process.subtitle: We follow a proven workflow that guarantees quality and transparency at every stage.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.desc: Initial meeting to understand your goals, style and target audience.

steps.title: Proposal
steps.desc: We send a detailed proposal with scope, price and timeline.

steps.title: Design
steps.desc: We create wireframes and mockups for your approval. 2 revision rounds.

steps.title: Development
steps.desc: We code the site with clean, responsive and optimized code.

steps.title: Launch
steps.desc: We configure domain, hosting and publish. We hand over all credentials.

steps.title: Support
steps.desc: 30-day guarantee for technical bug fixes after launch.

landing.name: Landing Express
features: Custom one-page professional design
Fully responsive for mobile, tablet & desktop
Contact form to receive client inquiries
WhatsApp, call & social media buttons
Fast loading so no visitor leaves before seeing your offer
Google Analytics included to track your visitors

menu_qr.name: Digital QR Menu
features: Visual design matching your brand and colors
Up to 50 dishes with photo, description and price
Custom QR code ready to print at the table
Simple panel to update dishes and prices yourself
Button for customers to order directly via WhatsApp
Works on any phone — no app download needed

portfolio.name: Portfolio Pro
features: Elegant design with animations and ultra-fast loading
Project gallery with categories and filters for easy browsing
"About me" page with optional downloadable CV
SEO configured so clients find you on Google by your specialty
Contact form with direct email notifications
Optimized for sharing on social media with custom preview image

restaurant.name: Restaurant Pro
restaurant.tagline: Complete site for your food business
features: Full website: home, menu, reservations, gallery, location & contact
Digital menu with custom QR + panel to update it yourself
Online reservation system with automatic email confirmation to guests
Photo gallery for ambiance, dishes and special events
Integrated map + local SEO to appear on Google Maps
Get notified of every new reservation by email and WhatsApp

wp_business.name: Business Website
features: Full website up to 8 pages, custom designed
Admin panel to update texts and images without any help
News or blog section to keep your clients informed
Contact and quote request forms
SEO configured from day one to rank on Google
Google Analytics and social media integration

ecommerce_store.name: Online Store
features: Complete store ready to sell from day one
Shopping cart, checkout and multiple payment methods
Panel to manage your orders, inventory and customers
Configurable discount coupons and promotions
Automatic emails for order confirmation, payment & tracking
Product SEO so customers find you on Google searches

blog.name: Pro Blog
features: Comfortable reading design and intuitive navigation
Categories, tags, search and article archive
Newsletter so readers subscribe and receive your updates
Moderated comments section + social sharing buttons
SEO configured so Google indexes and ranks your articles
Simple editor to publish new content without technical help

custom.name: Custom System
features: Features designed exactly around your business needs
Your own admin panel to manage your platform independently
Connected to services you already use (payments, bookings, CRM…)
User system with differentiated roles and permissions
Training so you and your team can use it from day one
60 days of support included after launch

questionnaire.step5_references_placeholder: Share 1–3 URLs of sites you admire...

questionnaire.step5_prior_brand_placeholder: Tell us about symbols, colors or visual environments you've used before to represent your business.
questionnaire.step5_logo_inspiration_label: What logos or brands do you like and why? (optional)
questionnaire.step5_logo_inspiration_placeholder: You can include names, URLs of competitor pages, images or any brand that inspires you.
